chapter.verse: Tua hangin Agrippa in Paul' kiangah, “Nang' lam pan na gen ding hong kiphal hi,” ci hi. Tua ciangin Paul in a khut zankhia-in a nuai-a bangin mawhloh lahtelna thu sungkhia hi:
“Kumpi Agrippa aw, kei' tunga Jew mite' hong ngawhnate tawh kisai-in tuni nangma' mai-ah mawhloh lahtelna thu a genkhia ta ding ka hih manin hampha ka kisa hi.
A diakin nang pen Jew mite' ngeina zatziate leh thumaanzaw a kituhnate uh a vekin theihpih na hih manin ka thugen lungduaitak nong ngaih ding kong thum hi.
“A tuung-a kipan ka mipihte lak leh Jerusalem ah om ka hih manin Jew mi khempeuh in ka khangno lai-a kipan ka khankhiatzia hong theih uh ahi hi.
Amaute in teci a pannop nak uhleh komau' biakna sungpan pawlke a ngatpen ahi Pharisee mi khatin nungta ka hihlam hong theih khitsa uh ahi hi.
Tu-in komau' pupite' Pasian' hong piaksa kamciam ka lametna hangin hih takah thusit thuakin ka ding hi.
Ko minam beh sawmlenihte in tua kamciam ngah ding ka lamet manun a sun a zan cilo-in hanciamin Pasian ka bia uh hi. Kumpipa aw, hih lametna hang mah hi, Jew mite in kei hong ngawhna uh!
Pasian in misite thosak cih thu, bang hangin note in up-huai lo ci-in ngaihsun na hi uh hiam?
“Keimahmah zong Nazareth khuami Jesu' min lehdo nadingin na tampi ka sep kul ci-in ka ngaihsun ngei hi.
Zong, Jerusalem ah ka sem pah hi. Siampi liante' kiangpan septheihna thu ka ngah khit ciangin mi siangtho tampitak thong ah ka khum a, amaute a kithah ciangin zong amau' lam ka pang kei hi.

Vengkhawm inn citeng ah zong amaute ka gawtbawl zelzel a, Pasian a gendai nadingun zawhthawh thu tawh ka hanciam hi. Amaute' tungah nakpi lungso lunghamin gamdang khuapite dong nangawn ah amaute ka va bawlsia hi.
“Hih vai tawh kizomin siampi liante' hong ap vaipuak leh septheihna thu tawh Damascus ka zin hi.
Sunkim laitak lamkal ah, kumpipa aw, vantung pan ni sangin a taangzaw khuavak khat ka mu a, kei leh ka tonpihte tawh komau' kimkot hong taan hi.

Ka vekun lei ah ka tuk laitakun awging khat in Hebrew-kam tawh kei hong hopih a, ‘Saul, Saul aw, bang hangin kei hong bawlsia na hi hiam? Khe tawh ganhawlna ciangzum na pek pen nang' ading thuak-hak lua hi,’ hong ci hi.
Kei zong, ‘Topa aw, kua na hi hiam?’ ka cih leh Topa in, ‘Nong bawlsiat Jesu ka hi hi.

Ahi zongin tu-in tho inla na khe tawh dingto in. A hang pen tua ding mah-a nang' kiangah hong kilang ka hi hi. Kei nong muhna thute leh nang' kiangah kong kilat lai ding thute teci a pang dingin nasemhuh khatin kong seh hi.
Na mipihte leh Gentile mite' kiangah kong sawlkhia ding a, amaute' kiangpan nang kong honkhia ding hi.

Tua mite in mawh maisakna ngahin kei hong upna uh hanga sianthona a ngah mite lakah tanh a neih theih nadingun amaute khuamial pan khuavak ah, Satan' ukna huang pan Pasian' kiangah, hong kihei nadingun a mit uh na va honsak ding hi,’ hong ci hi.
“Tua ahih manin Kumpi Agrippa aw, kei pen vantung kihilna muhtuam thu a manglo ka hikei hi.

Tua sangsikin a masa-in Damascus khua-a omte, a zom ah Jerusalem khua leh Judea gam sung mun citenga omte, leh Gentile mite' kiangah mawhna kisikin Pasian' kiangah a kihei nading uh cih thu leh kisikna tawh a kituak gamtatna a neih nading uh cih thu ka tangko hi.
Tua thu hangin Jew mite in biakinnpi sungah kei hong man uh a, thah hong sawm uh hi.
Tuni ciangdong Pasian' kiangpan huhna ka ngah hi. Tua hangin kamsangte leh Moses in hong piang ding a cih uh thute a neu a lian' tungah teci ka pang a, tua longal thudang khat zong ka gen kei hi.
Ka gen thu pen Khris gimthuak dingin laitansa hi, cih thu leh misite' lakpan a thokik masapen ahihna tawh amah in i mipihte leh Gentile mite' kiangah khuavak hong pulak ding hi, cih thu ahi hi.”
Hih bangin Paul in mawhloh thu lahtelna a gen laitak awging lianpi tawh Festus hong pau a, “Paul aw, mihai na hita hi. Lai tampi na theihna in haina lam hong tun hi,” ci hi.
Ahi zongin Paul in, “Zahtak-huai Festus aw, kei ka hai kei a, thumaan leh thulam a tawn thute a gen ka hizaw hi.
A hang pen kumpipa in hih thute a theih hi a, ama' kiangah hangtak a gen ka hi hi. Hih thute pen kawmlak-a kisem hilo ahih manin ama' theihkhak loh khat zong omin ka um kei hi.
Kumpi Agrippa aw, kamsangte na um hiam? Na up lam kong thei hi,” ci hi.
Agrippa in Paul' kiangah, “Tawmvei sungin Khristian a suak dingin hong zol hi mawk lo na hi hiam?” ci hi.
Paul in, “Tawmvei ahi-a sauvei ahi zongin nang bek hilo, tuni-a ka thugen a za mi khempeuh, hih kolbulh khaukhih vai losiah kei bang dan hong suah nadingun Pasian' kiangah thu ka ngen hi,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa dingto a, gam-uk mangpa-a kipan Bernice leh a tutpih teng zong dingto uh hi.
A ciahkhiat kawmun khatlekhat kiho uh a, “Hih mipa in sihna leh kolbulh khaukhih tawh kituak thu bangmah bawl lo hi,” kici uh hi.
Tua ciangin Agrippa in Festus' kiangah, “Hih mipa in Caesar' kiangah thumbehna na puakto hikeileh a kikhah thei ding hita lel hi,” ci hi.
